card.name: Reporting verbs in science news
card.fires_on: Words in science news that attribute a finding to researchers or a study, such as quoted, says, study, or according to. It fires just before the text names the journal, author, or publication.

modes.label: Attribution verbs
modes.description: A verb or phrase that credits a researcher or outlet with a statement.
modes.example: the BBC<< quoted>> Dr Romain Vullo of the University

modes.label: Study or lead author
modes.description: The word study or lead right before an author's name or role.
modes.example: said<< study>> author Kari Stefansson, who is

modes.label: Findings reported in journal
modes.description: Words linking a study or discovery to where it was published.
modes.example: The details of the discovery<< are>> published in the journal Naturwissenschaften

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward published, as in a paper published in a journal, or toward lead author.
card.plain: It spots news text crediting a study or researcher and expects the word published or an author's name next.
